question:
Create a new KiCad project named b35 in the project directory and draw its schematic for the following request.

Build an nRF52840 Pro Micro-style module using a Raytac MDBT50Q-1MV2, USB-C, a TP4057 LiPo charger, and an XC6220B331MR-G 3.3 V regulator. Include the USB/battery Schottky/P-MOSFET power path, a P-MOSFET-switched external 3.3 V output controlled by P1.09 with a 2M pull-down, battery sensing on P0.04 through an 820k/2M divider, a blue LED on P1.10, charge and VBUS LEDs, and a 32.768 kHz crystal. Include the charger and its programming resistor in the schematic; choose its value for the intended cell. SWD is a two-pin SWDIO/SWCLK header.
First 1x13 row: GND, P0.06, P0.08, GND, GND, P0.15, P0.17, P0.20, P0.13, P0.24, P0.09, P0.10, P1.06. Second row: VBAT, VBUS, GND, RESET/P0.18, switched external 3.3 V, P0.30, P0.31, P0.29, P0.02, P1.13, P0.03, P0.28, P1.11. Test pads expose P1.12, P1.14, P1.15, P0.05, P0.07, P0.11, P0.12. Include an open jumper between P1.04 and P1.11 for the alternate module variant. Use the supplied regulator/charger symbols and module footprint.
Local dependencies: Use the project-local symbol library (MDBTMicro_library.kicad_sym) and footprint library (MDBTMicro_library.pretty) in lib/ under the project directory; use standard KiCad libraries for everything else.
answer:
Created the [b35 KiCad project](</home/modernmariner/Projects/Agentic AI for Circuit Design/EDA_Agent/eval/output/b35/run7/b35.kicad_pro>) and its schematic. No PCB layout or manufacturing files were produced.

The netlist was checked against the requested headers, test pads, power path, LEDs, crystal and jumper. **ERC reports zero errors and one warning:** the corrected TP4057 symbol differs from its library copy. The supplied symbol lacked a PROG pin number, so I created `TP4057_corrected`; its pinout should be checked against the selected part’s datasheet.

Assumptions and operating notes:

- A protected single-cell LiPo suitable for at least **100 mA** charging; 10 kΩ sets approximately 100 mA.
- P1.09 **low enables** the external 3.3 V output. The MOSFET body diode does not prevent backfeeding from that output.
- The crystal load capacitors assume a 12.5 pF crystal and approximately 3.5 pF stray capacitance per side.
- The two-pin SWD header needs ground and target-voltage reference connections via the row pins. P0.09/P0.10 require NFC-to-GPIO configuration.
